With the announcement that the game will be released on April 8, 2027, we know now that a physical edition is happening.
The Premium Plus Edition includes everything in the Premium Edition plus the digital soundtrack, artbook, and a handful of in-game items; it costs $109.99.
Close The most expensive version, however, is the $349.99 physical Collector's Edition.

On Thursday, shortly after revealing a big new trailer for Final Fantasy 7 Revelation and announcing the game’s release date of April 7, 2027, Square Enix began selling a new $85 FF7 trilogy bundle that includes digital versions of Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade, Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth, and the upcoming Final Fantasy 7 Revelation.
$85 for all three games is a heck of a good deal when you consider that FF7 Remake Intergrade alone is typically $40 by itself.
Meanwhile, FF7 Rebirth is $50 after a price drop earlier this year.
So this $85 bundle includes all three games for $5 less than it costs to buy the first two entries.

Available both individually or as part of a Story Expansion Pass, the two story DLC packs will first focus on Sephiroth then Vincent and the Turks, and will release sometime between "Winter 2027 and Spring 2028".
